claims.quote: Betta kuehnei is a paternal mouthbrooding labyrinth fish from Kelantan state, northeastern Peninsular Malaysia, and neighbouring Narathiwat, Thailand.
Betta kuehnei is a paternal mouthbrooding labyrinth fish from Kelantan state, northeastern Peninsular Malaysia, and neighbouring Narathiwat, Thailand.
The most recently described species is Betta kuehnei from the northernmost province Kelantan of Malaysia and the southernmost parts of Thailand.
